tools.name: find_postcode
tools.description: Look up a Swiss postcode: municipalities, canton and BAG premium region. Use it when a postcode may cover several municipalities.

tools.name: compare_insurance
tools.description: Rank every insurer, model and deductible for one person by the full yearly cost for 2027 (premiums plus the bills they pay themselves). Returns the best options, the best deductible, the break-even point, the worst case and the saving against their current insurance.

tools.name: draft_switch_letter
tools.description: Write the German letter to cancel basic insurance (Kündigung) or to change deductible or model with the same insurer. The person prints it, signs it by hand and posts it so it arrives by 30 November. Nothing is stored.

tools.name: switching_deadlines
tools.description: The dates that matter for changing Krankenkasse, model or deductible for 2027, with days left from today.
